newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to auction third of six rail sections Fri.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to auction third of six rail sections Fri.

text.p: Brazil will auction Friday, for a minimum price of 888.9 million reais, a 30-year concession to operate the third of the six sections of the federal railway network included in the country's privatization program.
Only one consortium, the MRS Logistica, has signed up for the auction, scheduled for 1400 local time/1700 GMT on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange (BVRJ).

The MRS Logistica, led by Brazilian steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN), also includes steel firm Cosigua, mining companies MBR and Ferteco, fertilizer company Ultrafertil, transport groups Celato and Interferrea and two pension funds.
Considered the filet mignon of the network, the 1,674 km southeast section, which accounts for 40 percent of the federal railway's turnover, is the only stretch to post a regular annual profit.
Earlier this year, Brazil auctioned concessions to operate the west and center-east sections.
